chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 502: The Heavenly Emperor's Bargain – Xiao Chen Seals a Pact for Five Hundred Years
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen enters the legendary Heavenly Emperor City, strikes a deal for five hundred years of cultivation time, and begins a brutal training to become a war-power half-ancestor. Three Otherworld Ancestral Gods pursue but fail.
og_description: Xiao Chen buys time with a promise of three Ancestral God souls. The city flees beyond the cosmos. A desperate pact sets the stage for future battles.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen gambles his future against three Ancestral God souls. The Heavenly Emperor City escapes beyond the cosmos.
